summary.text: Max Burns, a Republican, was elected in November 2020 to Georgia Senate District 23.

paragraphs.text: He served on the Screven County Board of Commissioners until 1998 and was elected in 2002 as the U.S. Representative for Georgia's 12th Congressional District, serving one term.
A Georgia native born in Millen, Burns earned his undergraduate degree at Georgia Tech in 1973, an MBA from Georgia State University in 1977 and a Ph.D. in 1987.
He served in the U.S. Army Reserves, was a professor at Georgia Southern University, and was president of Gordon State College from 2012 to 2017.
